# hpe_morpheus_backup (Data Source)

Reads a Morpheus backup by its ID or name.

## Example Usage

### Look up by ID

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_backup" "example" {
  id = 99
}
```

### Look up by Name

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_backup" "example" {
  name = "Example Backup"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the Backup
- `name` (String) Name of the Backup

### Read-Only

- `backup_provider` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_provider))
- `backup_repository` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_repository))
- `backup_type` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_type))
- `container_id` (Number) Present when locationType is `instance`
- `cron_expression` (String) Cron Expression
- `date_created` (String) Date Created
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled
- `host` (Attributes) Present when locationType is `server` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--host))
- `instance` (Attributes) Present when locationType is `instance` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instance))
- `job` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--job))
- `last_result` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--last_result))
- `last_status` (String) Last Status
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated
- `location` (String) Location label, typically the storage provider name
- `location_type` (String) Source Type (instance, server, storage)
- `next_fire` (String) Next Fire
- `retention_count` (Number)
- `schedule` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `stats` (Attributes) Backup Result Statistics (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stats))
- `storage_provider` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_provider))
- `target_all` (Boolean) Whether to backup all databases. Present when backupType is a database type.
- `target_host` (String) Target host. Present when backupType is a database type (MySQL, SqlServer, Postgres, MongoDB) or lvmSnapshot.
- `target_name` (String) Target database name. Present when backupType is a database type and `targetAll` is false.
- `target_password` (String) Target password (masked). Present when backupType is a database type.
- `target_password_hash` (String) Target password hash. Present when backupType is a database type.
- `target_path` (String) The file or directory path on the target host. Present when backupType is `fileBackup`, `directoryBackup`, or `tarDirectoryBackup`.
- `target_port` (Number) Target port. Present when backupType is a database type (MySQL, SqlServer, Postgres, MongoDB).
- `target_username` (String) Target username. Present when backupType is a database type.
- `volume_path` (String) Volume path. Present when backupType is `lvmSnapshot`.
